# How battles work
- Teams of up to 5 fight automatically. The frontline is the first living card in line.
- Every round, each card attacks the enemy frontline once. Each hit it lands gives **+1 mana**.
- When a card's mana reaches its ability cost (2-5), the ability fires right away. It still attacks as normal.
- Stunned cards skip their attack (and so gain no mana that turn).
- Damage varies by +/-5%. Crits: 5% chance, 1.5x damage.
- **Sudden Death:** from round 15, all damage grows by +25% every round, so fights always end.
- Hard cap: 50 rounds. If both teams survive, the team with more total HP % wins.

# Roles, counters and team bonuses
**Counter cycle:** Tank > DPS > Support > Tank
- Tanks take 10% less damage from DPS.
- DPS deal 10% more damage to Supports.
- Supports deal 10% more damage to Tanks, and their heals/shields/buffs/debuffs are 10% stronger while the enemy frontline is a Tank.
- Enemy ATK debuffs can never stack past -20%.

**Team role bonus** (per card of the same role: 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5): +5% / +10% / +15% / +18% / +20%
- DPS: +ATK. Tank: +Max HP. Support: stronger heals, shields, buffs and debuffs.

**Standard passives**
- Drain: heals 15% of damage taken.
- Rage: +6% ATK per hit landed, up to 5 stacks.
- Executioner: +30% damage to targets below 35% HP.
- Medic: end of every round, heals the lowest-HP ally for 4% of their Max HP.
- Battery: whenever any card dies, allies gain 1 mana.

# Card stats formula
**ATK / HP = role base x rarity x subrole x card modifier**, rounded to the nearest 10.
- Role base: DPS 60 / 500, Tank 30 / 1120, Support 30 / 650
- Rarity: Common x1, Uncommon x1.2, Rare x1.45, Epic x1.75, Legendary x2.1, Mythic x2.5, God x3, Secret x3.5
- Subrole: Duelist 1.1x ATK / 0.95x HP, Skirmisher 0.9x ATK / 1x HP, Vanguard 0.9x ATK / 1.1x HP, Juggernaut 1.2x ATK / 0.95x HP, Enchanter 1x ATK / 1x HP, Hexer 1x ATK / 1x HP

# Fusion (levelling cards with spares)
- Every duplicate you pull becomes a **spare copy** (fusion fuel).
- Cards level from +0 to +10. Reaching +N costs **N points** of fuel from the **same rarity**.
- A spare copy of the **same card** is worth **2 points**; any other same-rarity spare is worth **1**.
- **+5 and +10 are milestones:** they need at least one real copy of that card.
- Each level adds **+5%** of the card's base ATK and HP (**+50% at +10**), rounded to the nearest 10.
- Maxing a card costs 55 points in total. The Fuse button spends other spares first and real copies last.
- +5 unlocks a silver foil border, +10 an animated gold one.
